title: Category:Repeatable Quests
html:
Repeatable quests are quests you can repeat time and time again. Repeatable quests are often limited to killing a certain amount of enemies, or just finding certain amounts of items. Some of these quests are only repeatable while the player is within the level limits of the dungeon.
